faq: Do I have to buy a theme?
No. The default PrestaShop themes are free and solid. If you prefer a paid theme from an add on marketplace, you buy the licence and we set it up for you.
How is this different from a redesign?
This starts from a ready made theme and tailors it, so it is quicker and cheaper. A redesign is built around your products and rebuilds key pages.
Can I keep editing the theme?
Yes. We use the theme options and page blocks wherever possible, and we leave a guide, so you can change text, images and banners without touching code.
Yes. We test on phone and tablet sizes and fix spacing, menus and tap targets before handover.
desc:
PrestaShop theme setup and branding starts from a well-built theme and tailors it to your store. Ecom Swift LLC helps you choose, installs it, applies your logo, colors and fonts, arranges the home page and checks it on a phone.

## What is PrestaShop theme setup and branding?

A PrestaShop theme is the template set that controls how your storefront looks: the layout of the home page, the category listings, the product pages and the menus. Theme setup is the work of choosing a suitable one, installing it correctly and configuring it. Branding is the step that makes it look like your business rather than a demo.

Together they give you a polished storefront faster than designing every page from nothing.

## Why starting from a proven theme is sensible

A mature theme comes with solved problems: responsive layouts, tested product pages, working menus and reasonable loading behavior. Designing all of that yourself costs time and carries risk. Starting from a theme that already works lets you spend your effort on what makes your shop different, which is your products and your brand.

The risk lies in the choice. A theme packed with features can slow the shop. A theme that does not match your range, such as one built for fashion when you sell tools, forces awkward workarounds. Choosing with care avoids both.

## How the right theme and branding help results

The right theme helps shoppers feel at ease. A layout that suits your products makes browsing natural. Consistent colors, fonts and buttons make the shop look like one business. A clean mobile layout keeps phone visitors reading and tapping rather than pinching and zooming.

Branding also builds recognition. When your logo, colors and tone appear in the same way on every page, repeat visitors know where they are. We cannot promise any particular sales outcome, but a clear and consistent storefront removes common reasons for doubt.

## What a well-tailored theme includes

- A shortlist of themes matched to your product type and budget for the theme itself.
- A correct installation of the chosen theme, with its required modules.
- Your logo, favicon, colors and fonts applied across the shop.
- A home page arranged with banners, featured products and categories.
- Menus and a footer built to match how shoppers navigate your range.
- Product page layout styled for your photos and options.
- Custom home blocks where the default sections do not fit.
- Category and filter styling so listings stay readable.
- A mobile layout check on real phone sizes.
- A child theme and a short guide so you can edit safely later.

## What we do

We begin with a short conversation about your products, your customers and the look you want. We prepare a shortlist of suitable themes and explain the differences in plain words. After you choose, we install it, apply your brand assets and arrange the home page.

The Basic package covers the shortlist, the installation, your branding and the home page arrangement. Standard adds menus, a footer, product page styling, a few custom home blocks and a mobile pass. Premium adds a child theme, more custom blocks, category and filter styling and a short video guide that shows how to edit content without breaking the design.

You buy the theme license yourself where a paid theme is needed. Our price covers the setup and tailoring work.

## What to do and what to avoid

**Do:**
- Share your logo files, brand colors and a few photos of your products.
- Choose a theme for how it suits your range, not only how the demo looks.
- Keep your first home page simple.
- Edit text and images through the back office tools we show you.
- Check the theme on your own phone.

**Avoid:**
- Installing several themes to compare them on the live shop.
- Choosing a theme loaded with features you will never use.
- Using more than two or three fonts.
- Editing theme files directly if you do not use a child theme.
- Mixing very different photo styles on one page.

## Who this is for

This service suits new shops that want a professional look quickly. It suits owners with a bare default theme who want it to reflect their brand. It also suits sellers who already own a theme license and need someone to configure it properly.

## How to get started

Send us a short note about what you sell, your brand assets and any stores whose look you admire. Add us as a staff or developer user so we can install and configure the theme, and please never send passwords. We reply with a checklist and the theme shortlist.
